Key responsibility: Direct incident response; declare, activate, escalate, authorise normal containment, coordinate decisions, and close or recommend closure
Normal decision authority: Incident Response Lead under Stage 1 authority
Alternate staffing assignment: Management-appointed deputy from IT Staff 2 or IT Staff 3; external incident director if authorised
Required competence: Incident coordination, risk-based decisions, evidence-aware leadership, service impact assessment
Support dependency: Senior Management, BCC, service owners, and external support when capacity is insufficient
Potential conflict: Command competes with hands-on technical work and recordkeeping
Source or governance reference: Stage 1 policy Section 5; governance plan Section 6

Key responsibility: Triage, correlate, analyse, assess severity and scope, and provide security validation
Normal decision authority: Analysis and security recommendations; no independent disruptive authority
Alternate staffing assignment: Authorised external specialist or trained IT support subject to approval
Required competence: Security monitoring, identity and cloud investigation, log analysis, uncertainty reporting
Support dependency: External forensics, malware analysis, cloud provider, and IT Operations
Potential conflict: Analysis may conflict with urgent containment or recovery validation
Source or governance reference: Task 1 integrated assessment; Stage 1 policy Sections 5–6

Key responsibility: Preserve evidence references, coordinate collection planning, and maintain provenance and custody records
Normal decision authority: Evidence-handling coordination within approved scope; no containment or restoration authority
Primary staffing assignment: IT Staff 3 — proposed dual-hat assignment or authorised external specialist
Alternate staffing assignment: External forensic provider or trained IT Staff 2 subject to approval
Required competence: Evidence preservation, secure storage, time-zone-aware records, custody principles
Support dependency: Specialist forensics and secure storage support may be required
Potential conflict: Evidence preservation may conflict with disruptive containment

Key responsibility: Assess dependencies and execute approved endpoint, server, identity, backup, and restoration work
Normal decision authority: Technical execution within approved scope; constrained emergency containment authority under Stage 1 conditions
Required competence: Windows/server, endpoint, identity, backup, network, and service dependencies
Support dependency: Backup, cloud identity, and recovery specialists may be required
Potential conflict: Technical execution may conflict with backup validation or business acceptance
Source or governance reference: Stage 1 policy Sections 5 and 7; isolation procedure

Key responsibility: Assess information classification, privacy, contractual, legal, safeguarding, and reporting-obligation questions
Normal decision authority: Advisory authority only; formal risk acceptance and external release remain with authorised management
Primary staffing assignment: Proposed internal adviser if available or authorised external counsel
Required competence: Privacy, legal, records, contractual, and regulatory analysis
Support dependency: External advice may require management authorisation and confidentiality arrangements
Potential conflict: Advice and communications approval must remain distinct

Key responsibility: Prepare and coordinate fact-bounded internal, learner, staff, and external communications
Normal decision authority: Communication preparation and coordination; Senior Management approves external release
Alternate staffing assignment: BCC, Academic/Business Service Owner, or authorised external communications support
Required competence: Clear writing, privacy-aware handling, audience coordination, alternate-channel use
Support dependency: Management approval, Privacy/Legal advice, and approved channels
Potential conflict: Drafting may conflict with message approval or unverified email use

Key responsibility: Coordinate authorised continuity arrangements and predefined low-risk preparations within delegation
Normal decision authority: Coordination only; Senior Management retains material activation and risk acceptance
Required competence: Continuity coordination, service prioritisation, resource coordination, examination planning
Support dependency: Academic/Business Service Owner, Incident Response Lead, and management
Potential conflict: Continuity pressure may conflict with security restrictions and recovery gates

Key responsibility: Define service impact and approve examination or business service arrangements within approved parameters
Normal decision authority: Business acceptance and examination arrangement approval within delegated parameters
Primary staffing assignment: Academic Operations or affected Business Service Owner — proposed role assignment
Required competence: Service dependency, learner impact, business acceptance, and continuity decisions
Support dependency: Incident Response Lead, IT Operations, Security Analyst, and management
Potential conflict: Business acceptance may conflict with security validation or technical recovery status

Key responsibility: Approve material risk, Critical decisions, material exceptions, extraordinary resources, continuity activation, and formal appointments
Normal decision authority: Institutional risk acceptance, material exception, continuity activation, and appointment authority
Primary staffing assignment: Senior Management / Executive Sponsor — scenario governance role, not a named person
Required competence: Risk acceptance, resource authorisation, governance oversight, and decision review
Support dependency: Incident Response Lead, advisers, service owners, and external providers
Potential conflict: Management decisions may be delayed by incomplete evidence or competing continuity pressure

Key responsibility: Obtain provider-side identity, mailbox, MFA, token, device, and audit-log assistance when authorised
Primary staffing assignment: Authorised IT Operations or provider support — contingent
Alternate staffing assignment: Microsoft 365 provider support or approved specialist
Required competence: Identity administration, provider processes, audit-log interpretation
Support dependency: Provider availability and contractual access are unverified
Potential conflict: Identity administration may conflict with compromise investigation and evidence preservation

Functional role: Backup / Recovery Specialist or Provider Liaison
Key responsibility: Support isolated backup validation and recovery engineering when internal capacity is insufficient
Primary staffing assignment: Authorised external specialist or provider — contingent
Alternate staffing assignment: IT Operations and approved recovery support
Required competence: Backup architecture, isolated validation, application consistency, recovery engineering
Support dependency: Management approval, availability, confidentiality, and validated scope
Potential conflict: Backup administration may conflict with independent backup-integrity validation
Source or governance reference: Stage 1 governance plan Section 8; business-continuity plan
